names.note: Read out of the name link behind days.pravoslavie.ru's line for 19 марта ст. ст., name page 14239, «Матрона (Алексеева), прмц.», with the rank word left off. The day's own line declines the name and gives the forename alone, «Прмц. Матроны».

death.note: The year days.pravoslavie.ru closes her line with for 19 марта ст. ст.: «Прмц. Матроны (1938).» It is the only year the calendar gives her, and neither the day page nor name page 14239 carries a life.

source.text: Православный церковный календарь, Сретенский монастырь (days.pravoslavie.ru), 19 марта ст. ст. — «Прмц. Матроны (1938).»

attestations.note: Neither the day page nor name page 14239 carries a life. The rank «Прмц.», преподобномученица, is read as `venerable-martyr`: on this calendar it is the word for a woman under monastic vows who died a martyr, and no office is written because the calendar names no monastery, no house and no grade. The name page gives the surname the line leaves out and lists a second day, «26 января (Новомуч.)», the synaxis of the new martyrs and confessors of Russia; it is recorded here and the folder does not render on it. The corpus was searched for the surname Алексеева and holds no folder of it; it holds twelve other folders of the forename and none of them is this woman.
